overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee approved the summer municipal newsletter, reviewed scheduling and coordination for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings, and discussed potential regulatory models to modernize the city's 1974 noise ordinance.

items.title: Summer Municipal Newsletter
items.summary: Approved and released the summer newsletter summarizing City Council activities and meetings from July and August.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Schedule
items.summary: Reviewed coordination logistics, publicity tactics, and school venue setups for the upcoming series of neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Revision
items.summary: Discussed updating the city's outdated 1974 noise ordinance using comparison models from neighboring municipalities and kept the matter in committee to develop a draft and consult stakeholders.
